title: Design System: World Cup 2026 Prediction Lab

shadows.name: flag-seat
shadows.purpose: Under rectangular flag images to seat them on the surface.

shadows.name: flag-seat-sm
shadows.purpose: Smaller flags in sidebar and group cards.

motion.name: ease-confident
motion.purpose: Default reveal and bar-growth easing; quiet exponential ease-out.

motion.name: reveal-up
motion.purpose: Single-pass section/card entrance; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: grow-bar
motion.purpose: Probability/contender bars grow once from the left.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one key action per view; gold gradient, near-black ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E9C46A, #C9A24B); color: #1A1407; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.62rem 1.5rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, transform 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F2D98C, #E9C46A); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F2D98C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default action; charcoal surface with ghost border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(22,32,58,.6); color: #F4F7FB; border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.18); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(30,42,70,.8); border-color: rgba(233,196,106,.35); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4C8DFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: KPI Card
components.description: Headline metric tile: uppercase label, large tabular value, optional delta.
components.html:
Championship Favourite
Argentina

components.css: .ds-kpi { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(22,32,58,.55), rgba(16,24,43,.55)); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.10); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px 22px 18px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-kpi:hover { border-color: rgba(233,196,106,.28); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-kpi-label { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .11em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8B98AF; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-kpi-value { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 27px; font-weight: 600; color: #F4F7FB; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kpi-delta { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; margin-top: 8px; color: #7DB0FF; }

components.name: Pipeline Chip
components.description: Static informational chip naming an ensemble model; blue dot leading.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(22,32,58,.6); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.14); border-radius: 99px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #D7DEEB; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4C8DFF; }

components.name: Contender Row (leader)
components.description: Signature broadcast ranking row; the leader variant flips blue to champion gold.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-cb-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 34px 1fr 70px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(22,32,58,.5), rgba(16,24,43,.5)); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.09); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px 18px; transition: border-color .2s ease, transform .18s ease; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-cb-row:hover { border-color: rgba(148,163,184,.22); transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-lead { border-color: rgba(233,196,106,.45); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(233,196,106,.10), rgba(16,24,43,.55)); } .ds-cb-pos { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: #E9C46A; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cb-flag { width: 34px; height: 23px; border-radius: 4px; background: #25304A; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.45); } .ds-cb-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #F4F7FB; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-cb-name span { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #8B98AF; margin-left: 8px; } .ds-cb-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 99px; background: rgba(148,163,184,.10); overflow: hidden; } .ds-cb-fill { height: 100%; width: 100%; border-radius: 99px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #C9A24B, #F2D98C); } .ds-cb-pct { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 600; color: #E9C46A; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

components.name: Outcome Bar
components.description: Segmented win/draw/win probability bar for a match prediction.
components.css: .ds-outcome { margin: 8px 0 4px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-outcome-bar { display: flex; height: 11px; border-radius: 99px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(148,163,184,.12); } .ds-outcome-legend { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; color: #8B98AF; margin-top: 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-outcome-legend b { color: #F4F7FB; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.northStar: The FIFA World Cup 2026 Broadcast Desk
narrative.overview: This is the on-screen graphics package of a serious televised football-intelligence desk, translated into a web dashboard. The canvas is a deep midnight blue and over it sit precise tabular numbers, a single FIFA-inspired gold reserved for the champion, and an electric blue that signals live computed data. It feels expensive, calm, and certain. The system is data-forward and decoration-back: typography and disciplined layout carry the design, depth comes from tonal layering on a near-black ground rather than heavy shadows, and motion is quiet and single-pass. It explicitly rejects rainbow/chart-junk visuals and toy/gimmicky treatments.
keyCharacteristics: Cinematic near-black canvas (#070B14) with subtle radial gold/blue atmosphere
One gold accent, champion-only; one electric blue for live data and probability
Space Grotesk for numbers and headings, Inter for body
Tabular numerals everywhere a figure appears
Flat-by-default surfaces; borders and tonal tints define cards, not drop shadows

rules.name: The Champion-Only Rule
rules.body: Gold is spent on ≤10% of any screen — the leader, the primary action, the active nav item, kickers. If gold is on a second team or a generic accent, it has been devalued. Blue, not gold, is the default data color.

rules.name: The Two-Hue Rule
rules.body: Gold and blue are the only saturated colors. A third accent is forbidden; new categories are distinguished by neutral value steps, not new hues.

rules.name: The Tabular-Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns align and values don't jitter on rerun.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk for headings and figures, Inter for everything else. No third typeface.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat at rest. On hover they respond by brightening their border and lifting 2px, never by gaining a drop shadow.

dos: Do keep gold champion-only — the leader, the primary CTA, the active nav item, kickers (≤10% of any screen). Default data color is electric blue (#4C8DFF).
Do apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (via Space Grotesk) to every figure.
Do define cards with a 1px ghost border (rgba(148,163,184,.10)) and a tonal gradient fill; brighten the border on hover instead of adding a shadow.
Do keep muted text at #8B98AF or lighter-ink, and verify ≥4.5:1 on the surface it sits on.
Do pair every probability color with its numeric label — color never carries meaning alone.
Do keep motion single-pass and confident (cubic-bezier(.22,.7,.2,1)), with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't build rainbow or chart-junk visuals. No third saturated hue, no decorative gradients on data, no chart that doesn't inform.
Don't use toy or gimmicky treatments — no emoji-as-UI, no mascots, no playful flourishes.
Don't spend gold on non-champion elements; a second gold item devalues the accent.
Don't add drop shadows to separate surfaces — if a card needs one, the tonal contrast is wrong.
Don't introduce a third typeface or pair two similar sans-serifs. Space Grotesk + Inter only.
Don't use light-gray body text on tinted surfaces 'for elegance'; it fails contrast.
